title: Add BlueFire logo to header navigation, hero section, and footer

requirements.summary: Add BlueFire logo to header navigation in top-left corner at medium size alongside company name
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the header/navigation area
Logo is positioned in the top-left corner
Logo size is medium (appropriate for navigation bar)
Logo appears alongside the 'BlueFire' text, not replacing it

file_operations.description: Create a new Header component with navigation bar containing the BlueFire logo from frontend/public/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png positioned in the top-left corner at medium size (approximately 40-48px height) alongside the 'BlueFire' company name text. Implement responsive design for mobile and desktop viewports using Tailwind CSS classes consistent with the existing cybersecurity theme.

Import and add the new Header component at the top of the App component, before the HeroSection, to establish the navigation bar across all pages. Ensure proper spacing and layout integration with existing sections.

requirements.summary: Add BlueFire logo to hero section at medium size alongside company name while maintaining visual hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the hero section
Logo is placed next to the 'BlueFire' company name text
Logo size is medium and proportionate to hero section typography
Logo maintains visual balance with existing hero content (tagline, CTAs, statistics)

file_operations.description: Modify the HeroSection component to include the BlueFire logo from frontend/public/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png at medium size (approximately 48-64px height) positioned alongside the 'BlueFire' company name text in the heading area. Adjust the layout to maintain visual hierarchy with the existing tagline, CTAs, and statistics. Use flexbox or grid layout to position the logo and text together, ensuring responsive behavior on mobile and desktop viewports.

requirements.summary: Add BlueFire logo to footer at medium size alongside company name for consistent branding
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the footer section
Logo is placed next to the 'BlueFire' text in the footer
Logo size is medium and consistent with other footer elements
Logo maintains visual consistency with header and hero placements

file_operations.description: Modify the Footer component to include the BlueFire logo from frontend/public/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png at medium size (approximately 32-40px height) positioned alongside the 'BlueFire' company name text in the branding area. Ensure the logo maintains visual consistency with the header and hero implementations, and integrates seamlessly with existing footer content (services list, contact information, copyright).

requirements.summary: Ensure BlueFire logo is properly referenced as a static asset from the uploaded image file
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is saved as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory
Logo is referenced consistently across header, hero, and footer components
Logo loads efficiently without external dependencies
Logo maintains transparent background and original quality

file_operations.description: Ensure the uploaded BlueFire logo image (shield with blue flames and red network nodes) is available as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png. Verify the image maintains its transparent background and original quality. This file will be referenced by the Header, HeroSection, and Footer components using the path '/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png'.
